summary: CRVL is a high-quality boring-middle name with a generally clean R/f/M disclosure profile (6 PASS / 4 MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY / 0 SEVERE / 0 RED). The fundamentals are unimpeachable: 33 years of zero debt, $99M operating cash flow, +11% revenue growth in FY24 ACCELERATING to +12.9% in the FY25 9-month YTD reported in the Feb 2025 10-Q, no going-concern indicators, no customer-revenue concentration, clean counterparty mirror. The flags are governance/forensic rather than operational: (1) 18-year tenure with small regional auditor Haskell & White on an $800M-revenue company is a structural audit-quality risk factor, especially when paired with a revenue-recognition CAM; (2) the 10-K named Chairman Gordon Clemons as a key person whose loss would be materially adverse, and he then retired abruptly 6 months later (Nov 26 2024), with the 10-K providing no advance succession-plan disclosure; (3) the Clemons axis (Chairman + affiliated 10%-owner Corstar Holdings) liquidated ~$25.7M of stock in the 12 months pre-cutoff, concentrated before the Dec 2024 stock-split announcement and the Nov 2024 retirement; (4) the 10-K body is silent on Corstar despite its 10%+ ownership, deferring entirely to the proxy. Net read: not a distressed name, not a lying name — but the orderly Clemons exit and the small-auditor structural risk argue against a pure LONG-tier ranking. -14.3% pre-cutoff drawdown looks like a routine valuation reset on a quality compounder after a 3-for-1 split, not a forensic distress signal.
